title: 第11章 下路的塔下强杀第12章 逐渐无敌的瑞雯

第十一章 下路的塔下强杀
击杀盲僧的整个过程也就四五秒，非常的迅速。由此可见现在苏环的装备伤害有多高了。
王清雅看得已经有些麻木了，她感觉或许这一把瑞雯能够拯救世界。
“清雅姐，这个拿断剑的英雄怎么那么厉害，一下子就杀了对面那个拳击手。”这时候李青青则是有些迷惑不解。
听到拳击手，王清雅差点笑喷，看着李青青那婴儿肥的脸蛋带着疑惑的神情。
太可爱了，一瞬间王清雅有点把持不住，不由得举起双手揉了揉王青青的脸蛋。
“啊呜，别捏啦，快告诉我答案啊，魂淡！”被捏得有些受不了的李青青，挣脱开了王清雅的双手。
脸颊鼓着，显得更加的可爱，气呼呼的看着王清雅。
“那不是拳击手，那是英雄盲僧，又叫李青。说起来跟青青的名字就差一个字呢。”
看着更加可爱的李青青，强忍着捏脸的冲动，随后想起盲僧的名字，有些惊讶的看着李青青说道。
“为什么名字跟我差不多的英雄，怎么会那么没用啊。一下子就被打死了。”李青青听后气急，有些疑惑道。
“不是盲僧没用，是瑞雯，嗯，就是这个拿断剑的英雄，太厉害了。青青，英雄联盟都出来四年了，你怎么连这么基础的知识都不知道啊。”
艰难的解释之后，王清雅也是困惑不已。
“你又不是不知道，英雄联盟出来的那时候，我刚初三，学习紧张呢。然后英雄联盟火了之后，我就高一了，住校生，家里还不给我买手机，一个月放假半天，暑假还要补习……”
越说李青青越想哭，她都不知道她高中三年原来这么的惨，到底是怎么渡过来的。
王清雅闻言，也是有些汗颜，没想到李青青还有那么悲惨的读书生涯。
“不哭不哭，这个玩家玩得不错哦，说不定这把能赢。”
岂止是不错，操作简直亮瞎眼，王清雅心里默默道。
“瞎子，你怎么回事，不是说了打稳一点，等下路推掉一塔，直接团中了吗。”
一听到系统提示音，豹女脸就黑了，这才计划了不到两分钟，说好的要打稳妥点，马上就又送出去一个人头。

现在瑞雯杀人剑在手，在上路击杀了潘森之后，已经叠起了两层，现在盲僧又送出了一个人头。
这杀人剑好像还出了不到几分钟吧，就飞快的叠起了四层，豹女不由得头疼了起来。
“我只是想拿个红，没想到瑞雯会在那蹲着。而且瑞雯在上路消失，潘森也没有提示，所以有些大意了。”
听到豹女的质问，盲僧有些艰涩的解释道，心中非常无奈，但是却对上路潘森抱怨起来。
潘森正在上路趁着瑞雯不在的时候，迅速的补兵升级，这时候已经三级了。听到这话，手中长矛一顿，随后嘴角微微撇了撇，很是不屑，但是他没有说话。
他知道要是他反驳什么的话，肯定又要被喷。
而作为一个上单坑成这样，还是一个英雄克制的上单，他没有什么底气去辩解。
见潘森不说话，盲僧也不咄咄逼人，毕竟是自己的失误问题。
苏环击杀了盲僧之后，杀人剑的层数也达到了四层。
随后他没有犹豫的直接收掉了己方的红BUFF，升到七级。
刚一收掉红BUFF，他正想去把对面的蓝BUFF也给一并收掉，以此来拖延豹女节奏的时候，突然听到一声呼救声。
“苏环，快，快！对面要强杀我了，快点过来。”袁世凯正在逃命的时候，正巧看到小地图上红BUFF处的瑞雯，随后转过头向着坐在自己旁边的苏环大声求救道。
苏环一听，视角转向下方，看见袁世凯的女警已经不足半血，而对面伊泽瑞尔却是满血状态，想来这是他旁边琴女的功劳。…………
一发秘术射击再次命中女警后，见对方女警已经只剩三分之一的血了。
伊泽瑞尔的心思渐渐有些活络起来，随后他一记普攻收下了一个蓝色方的残血小兵，升到了六级。
到达了六级，便点了大招‘精准弹幕’，技能甫一点下，伊泽瑞尔便是迫不及待一个‘精准弹幕’瞄准女警弹射而出。
袁世凯一看，脸都吓白了，这一下要被刮到估计不死也得残了。
毫不犹豫的一个闪现向着上方交出，而正在这时伊泽瑞尔的‘精准弹幕’已经以极快的速度飞射而来。
“刮不到，刮不到……”袁世凯嘴中念念有词。
但是接下来的一幕，却是让他绝望了。

或许是因为闪现用得太过于紧张的缘故，闪现的距离有点短，还是被伊泽瑞尔的大招‘精准弹幕’边缘给击中，一瞬间又打掉袁世凯女警的一截血量。
只不过当伊泽瑞尔攻击到女警的时候，防御塔的仇恨却是被吸引了过去，一道能量晃晃悠悠的飘射而来，打在伊泽瑞尔的身上。
“琴女，准备强杀。”看着已经残血将近死血的女警，伊泽瑞尔心头一阵火热，对于防御塔的伤害毫不在意。
这个人头必定能收下，而且这还是紫色方第一个人头，收下的话，肯定能增加己方的气势。
不至于让紫色方的英雄们颓废异常，要知道当瑞雯在上路和野区一共拿下四个人头的时候，紫色方这把还差点吵了起来。
“行，不过我们已经没有兵线了。”一记‘坚毅咏叹调’稍微补充了伊泽瑞尔的血量后，琴女却是有些担忧道。
“没事，女警的那点血量，只要再被我一记‘秘术射击’再加两下普攻就可以收下人头了。”话音刚落，伊泽瑞尔就是一个奥术跃迁，闪出防御塔的攻击范围，迅速接近女警，随后一记‘秘术射击’紧随其上。
看见对面伊泽瑞尔快速的跟上，袁世凯想也不想，操纵着女警就是一个‘90口径绳网’对着其使出，往后退了一段距离，顺便还减速了对方。
但是伊泽瑞尔的‘秘术射击’她却并没有躲过去，还是被击中在身上，又掉了一小截血量。
这时袁世凯女警的血量已经是死血线了，达到濒临死亡，被摸一下就死的状态。
看着女警的血量，伊泽瑞尔一记‘精华跃动’射出，但是由于距离有点远，却是没有命中。
而由于被女警的‘90口径绳网’命中，现在正是减速状态所以，普攻也打不着对方。
但是伊泽瑞尔却是杀人心切，打不着女警，便是白光一闪，直接闪现逼近。
就在伊泽瑞尔普攻能量要发出的时候，却是发现女警已经躲进草丛，往蓝色方石像鬼的方向跑去。
“草！”
伊泽瑞尔心中一阵恼怒，虽说女警是必定跑不掉的，但是这样拖延着死亡时间却是令人愤怒。
无奈，见女警进草丛，伊泽瑞尔也是速度跟上。

Chapter 11 Forced Kill under the Tower in the Bottom Road
The whole process of killing the blind monk only takes four or five seconds, which is very fast. This shows how high the damage Su Huan's equipment is now.
Wang Qingya felt a little numb after seeing it. She felt that maybe this Ruiwen could save the world.
"Sister Qingya, why is this hero with the broken sword so powerful? He killed the boxer opposite him in one go." At this time, Li Qingqing was a little confused.
Wang Qingya almost laughed when she heard about the boxer, looking at Li Qingqing's baby-fat face with a puzzled expression.
It was so cute that Wang Qingya couldn't control it for a moment and couldn't help but raise her hands to rub Wang Qingqing's face.
"Oh, stop squeezing, tell me the answer quickly, Hun Dan!" Li Qingqing, who couldn't bear the squeezing, broke away from Wang Qingya's hands.
Her cheeks were bulging, making her look even cuter, and she looked at Wang Qingya angrily.
"That's not a boxer, that's the heroic blind monk, also called Li Qing. It's just one word different from Qing Qing's name."
Looking at the cuter Li Qingqing, she resisted the urge to pinch her face. Then she remembered the name of the blind monk and looked at Li Qingqing in surprise.
"How could a hero with a name similar to mine be so useless? He was beaten to death all at once." Li Qingqing was furious after hearing this and said with some confusion.
"It's not that the blind monk is useless, it's Ruiwen. Well, this hero with the Broken Sword is so awesome. Qingqing, it's been four years since League of Legends came out. Why don't you even know such basic knowledge?"
After the difficult explanation, Wang Qingya was also confused.
"It's not like you don't know that when League of Legends came out, I was in my third year of junior high school and I was very nervous about studying. Then after League of Legends became popular, I became a freshman in high school. I was a dormitory student. My family didn't buy me a mobile phone. I had half a day off every month, and I had to take extra classes during the summer vacation..."
The more she talked about Li Qingqing, the more she wanted to cry. She didn't know how she survived the three years of high school that were so miserable.
Wang Qingya was a little ashamed when she heard this. She didn't expect that Li Qingqing would have such a miserable academic career.
"Don't cry, don't cry. This player played well. Maybe he can win this one."
Not only is it good, the operation is simply blinding, Wang Qingya said silently in her heart.
"Blind man, what's the matter with you? Didn't you say that you should be cautious and wait for the bottom lane to knock down a tower and hit the group directly?"
As soon as she heard the system prompt, Leopard Girl's face turned dark. She had only planned for less than two minutes. She had promised to be more cautious and send out another head right away.
Now that Riven's murderous sword is in hand, after killing Panson on the road, it has been stacked twice, and now the blind monk has sent another head.
This murderous sword seemed to have been out for less than a few minutes, and it quickly stacked up four layers, causing Leopard Girl to have a headache.
"I just wanted to get a red, but I didn't expect that Riven would be squatting there. Moreover, Riven disappeared on the top lane, and Pan Sen didn't give any warning, so I was a little careless."
Hearing Leopard Girl's question, Blind Monk explained in a somewhat difficult manner, feeling very helpless, but he complained to Pan Sen on the road.
Pan Sen was on the road and took advantage of Riven's absence to quickly replenish his troops and upgrade them. At this time, he was already at level three. Hearing this, he paused with the spear in his hand, and then curled the corners of his mouth slightly in disdain, but he did not speak.
He knew that if he refuted anything, he would definitely be criticized again.
And as a top laner who was tricked like this, and a top laner with heroic restraint, he had no confidence to defend himself.
Seeing that Pan Sen didn't speak, the blind monk didn't act aggressively. After all, it was his own mistake.
After Su Huan killed the blind monk, the number of layers of the murderous sword reached four.
Then he took away his own red BUFF without hesitation and raised it to level seven.
As soon as he took away the red BUFF, he was about to take away the blue BUFF on the opposite side to delay the Leopard Girl's rhythm when he suddenly heard a cry for help."Su Huan, hurry, hurry! The other side is trying to kill me, come here quickly." When Yuan Shikai was running for his life, he happened to see Ruiwen in the red buff on the mini map, and then turned his head and shouted for help to Su Huan, who was sitting next to him.
When Su Huan heard this, he turned his perspective downwards and saw that Yuan Shikai's policewoman was already at less than half health, while Ezreal on the opposite side was at full health. He thought this was due to the piano girl next to him. …………
After a secret shot hit the policewoman again, she saw that the other policewoman had only one-third of her health left.
Ezreal's mind gradually became more active, and then he took down a blue-side minion with residual health with a basic attack, rising to level six.
After reaching level six, he clicked on the ultimate skill 'Precision Barrage'. As soon as he activated the skill, Ezreal couldn't wait to launch a 'Precision Barrage' aimed at the policewoman.
When Yuan Shikai saw it, his face turned pale with fright. If he was scratched this time, he would probably be disabled or not dead.
Without hesitation, he flashed forward and handed it over upwards, and at this moment, Ezreal's 'precision barrage' was already flying towards him at an extremely fast speed.
"It can't be scratched, it can't be scratched..." Yuan Shikai muttered something.
But the next scene made him despair.
Perhaps because the flash was used too nervously, the distance of the flash was a bit short, but he was still hit by the edge of Ezreal's ultimate move 'Precision Barrage', which instantly knocked out a chunk of policewoman Yuan Shikai's health.
However, when Ezreal attacked the policewoman, the hatred of the defense tower was attracted, and a swaying energy shot out and hit Ezreal.
"Quinna, prepare to kill by force." Looking at the policewoman who was almost dead, Ezreal's heart felt hot, and he didn't care about the damage caused by the defense tower.
This head can definitely be taken, and it is the first head of the purple side. If it is taken, it will definitely increase one's own momentum.
This will not make the heroes of the purple side extremely decadent. You must know that when Riven took a total of four kills in the top lane and the jungle, the purple side almost started a quarrel.
"Okay, but we no longer have a military line." After a 'Aria of Perseverance' slightly replenished Ezreal's health, Qin Nu said with some worry.
"It's okay. With the policewoman's little health, she can kill her with just one more 'secret shot' and two more basic attacks from me." As soon as he finished speaking, Ezreal made an arcane leap, slipped out of the attack range of the defense tower, and quickly approached the policewoman, followed closely by a 'secret shot'.
Seeing Ezreal on the other side quickly following up, Yuan Shikai didn't even think about it. He controlled the policewoman to use a '90-caliber rope net' on her, retreated a distance, and also slowed down the opponent.
However, she did not dodge Ezreal's 'Secret Shot', and was still hit on her body, losing another small amount of blood.
At this time, policewoman Yuan Shikai's blood volume was already at the death line. She was on the verge of death and would die if she was touched.
Looking at the policewoman's health, Ezreal shot an 'Essence Jump', but because the distance was a bit far, it missed.
And because he was hit by the policewoman's '90-caliber rope net', he was currently in a deceleration state, so he couldn't hit the opponent with his basic attacks.
But Ezreal was eager to kill, and when he couldn't hit the policewoman, he flashed a white light and approached directly.
Just when Ezreal's basic attack energy was about to be released, he discovered that the policewoman had hidden in the grass and ran towards the blue gargoyle.
"Grass!"
Ezreal felt angry in his heart. Although the policewoman would definitely not be able to escape, it was infuriating to delay the time of death like this.
Helplessly, when he saw the policewoman entering the grass, Ezreal followed up quickly.
